id: 13_Replace the Laser Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机激光电源的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/13_Replace the Laser Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/13_Replace the Laser Power Supply for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K14: 断开船形开关的四根线
points.K19: 支架装上新电源，贴回膜
points.K20: 放回主机，插端子，拧螺钉
points.K21: 五根线接回，线色对端子

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机旁，机内露出一个银色长方形电源模块，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine whose side is open, showing a long silver power supply module inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的激光电源怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机激光电源的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：闪电电池、磁环、两只手托箱子、交接本
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a battery with a lightning bolt, a black ferrite ring on a cable, two hands supporting a box from below and a handover notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 高压储能、走线细节、搬运和交接都要管。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下焊枪扳机，焊机报警灯闪，没有出光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the welding gun trigger; a red warning light flashes on the machine and nothing happens.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊机报警，焊枪不出光了。

shots.scene: 老李检查后，指着机内的银色电源模块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer finishes checking and points at the silver power supply module inside the machine.
shots.narration: 老李判断：要更换激光电源。

shots.scene: 老李看看手表，墙上时钟快到下班时间
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer glances at his watch; the wall clock shows it is almost the end of the day.
shots.narration: 活儿多，今天可能干不完。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 激光电源维修，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 老李把焊机电源开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the main power switch of the laser welding machine to off.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先关机断电。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 银色电源模块示意，内部亮着闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of the silver power supply module with a glowing lightning bolt icon inside and an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 残余高压，说的就是这个激光电源。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套用电压测试仪测电源端子，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in insulated gloves checks the power supply terminals with a voltage tester; its screen is blank.
shots.narration: 按说明书等待，再测量确认。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把一字螺丝刀、剪刀、四根扎带和新电源模块
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, one flat-head screwdriver, a pair of scissors, four cable ties and a new silver power supply module. No people.
shots.narration: 两把十字刀、一字刀、剪刀和扎带。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty and the unplugged cables coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the machine.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板。

shots.scene: 老李拆送丝安装板周边螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder mounting plate.
shots.narration: 拆下安装板十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screw of the yellow-green earth wire.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线螺钉。

shots.scene: 安装板放平，露出机内电气区和上方的电源模块
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate is laid outward, revealing the wiring and the silver power supply module at the top of the cabinet.
shots.narration: 放平安装板。

shots.scene: 剪刀小心剪断捆线的扎带
shots.prompt_en: Scissors carefully snip a cable tie holding a bundle of wires, leaving the wires intact.
shots.narration: 剪断四根扎带，别剪到线。

shots.section_title: 断开船形开关的四根线
shots.scene: 一字螺丝刀松开船形开关背面的端子，四根线依次取下
shots.prompt_en: A flat-head screwdriver loosens the terminals on the back of a rocker switch and four wires are removed one by one.
shots.narration: 用一字刀断开船形开关的四根线。
overlay: 断开船形开关的四根线

shots.scene: 十字刀拧松电源模块端子，五根线取下
shots.prompt_en: A cross-head screwdriver loosens the terminal screws on the power supply module and five wires are removed.
shots.narration: 用十字刀断开电源上的五根线。

shots.scene: 老李拧下电源支架的固定螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws fixing the power supply bracket to the cabinet.
shots.narration: 拆下固定支架的六颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拔下电源上的黑色插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unplugs a black connector from the power supply module.
shots.narration: 拔下电源上的黑色端子。

shots.scene: 老李双手托着电源组件取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the power supply assembly out with both hands under it.
shots.narration: 把整个电源组件取出来。

shots.scene: 单手拎电源、电源滑落砸脚的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a heavy module held with one hand slipping down onto a foot, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电源很沉，单手拎容易滑落砸伤。

shots.scene: 老李双手托底，脚上穿着劳保鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer carries the module with both hands supporting it from below, wearing safety shoes.
shots.narration: 双手托底，穿好劳保鞋。

shots.scene: 旧电源放在铺了绝缘垫的台面上，端子朝内，贴空白警示标签
shots.prompt_en: The old power supply module rests on an insulating mat with its terminals facing inward and a blank warning label stuck on it. No people.
shots.narration: 拆下的旧电源，仍可能存着电。

shots.scene: 手指碰旧电源端子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger touching the terminals of a removed power module, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 端子朝内放好，不用手碰。

shots.scene: 电源放在台面，撕开侧面保护膜
shots.prompt_en: On the bench, the protective film on the side of the bracket is peeled back.
shots.narration: 撕开两侧的保护膜。

shots.scene: 每侧拧下四颗螺钉，支架和旧电源分开
shots.prompt_en: Four screws are removed from each side and the black bracket is separated from the old power supply.
shots.narration: 每侧拆四颗螺钉，卸下支架。

shots.section_title: 支架装上新电源，贴回膜
shots.scene: 支架装到新电源上，每侧四颗螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The black bracket is fitted onto the new power supply and four screws are tightened on each side.
shots.narration: 支架装上新电源，每侧四颗螺钉。
overlay: 支架装上新电源，贴回膜

shots.section_title: 支架装上新电源，贴回膜
shots.scene: 手指按压，把两侧保护膜贴平
shots.prompt_en: Fingers press the protective films flat on both sides of the bracket.
shots.narration: 压平两侧保护膜。

shots.section_title: 放回主机，插端子，拧螺钉
shots.scene: 新电源组件放回机内，插上黑色端子
shots.prompt_en: The new power supply assembly is placed back into the cabinet and the black connector is plugged in.
shots.narration: 放回主机，插上黑色端子。
overlay: 放回主机，插端子，拧螺钉

shots.section_title: 放回主机，插端子，拧螺钉
shots.scene: 六颗螺钉拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Six screws are tightened to secure the power supply assembly.
shots.narration: 装上六颗螺钉固定。

shots.section_title: 五根线接回，线色对端子
shots.scene: 画面一角接线参考图，五根不同颜色的线接到端子，端子处空白
shots.prompt_en: A small reference picture in the corner while five wires of different colors are connected to blank terminals on the power supply.
shots.narration: 五根线接回电源。
overlay: 五根线接回，线色对端子

shots.section_title: 五根线接回，线色对端子
shots.scene: 参考图和实物端子用虚线一一对应
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank reference wiring picture and the real terminals with matching dotted lines between same-colored wires. No people.
shots.narration: 每根线的颜色，必须对上端子。

shots.scene: 几根导线绕过一个黑色圆形磁环
shots.prompt_en: Close view of several wires looped through a black ring-shaped ferrite core. No people.
shots.narration: 这几根线要从黑色磁环里穿过。

shots.scene: 导线没穿磁环的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of wires bypassing the ferrite ring, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 穿几圈、怎么穿，照原样不省略。

shots.scene: 设备屏幕出现波浪干扰图标
shots.prompt_en: A machine display showing a wavy interference icon. No people.
shots.narration: 省掉磁环，干扰会让设备工作异常。

shots.scene: 四根线接回船形开关背面端子
shots.prompt_en: Four wires are reconnected to the terminals on the back of the rocker switch.
shots.narration: 四根线接回船形开关。

shots.scene: 老李用四根扎带把线缆捆好
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer bundles the cables neatly with four cable ties.
shots.narration: 用四根扎带把线缆固定好。

shots.scene: 扎带勒进线皮的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cable tie biting deep into a cable jacket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 扎得太紧，会勒伤线皮。

shots.scene: 线缆贴着钣金锐边和发热元件的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cable rubbing against a sharp metal edge and touching a hot component, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆不贴锐边，不碰发热件。

shots.scene: 线缆沿线槽走，过孔处套着护线圈
shots.prompt_en: Cables run along a cable channel and pass through a hole fitted with a rubber grommet. No people.
shots.narration: 顺着原来的路走，过孔有护圈。

shots.scene: 老李抬回安装板，接送丝电机线，装回接地线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back, plugs in the wire feeder motor cable and refits the earth wire.
shots.narration: 接回电机线和接地线。

shots.scene: 螺钉全部装回，关上门板
shots.prompt_en: All screws are refitted and the side door is closed.
shots.narration: 装回螺钉，关好门板。

shots.scene: 机器门开着，挂空白警示牌，旁边插头锁着
shots.prompt_en: The machine stands with its side open, a blank warning tag hanging on it and its power plug locked in a plug lockout box. No people.
shots.narration: 活没干完要下班，机器不能敞着走。

shots.scene: 老李在交接本上写下进度，小研签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes the progress in a blank handover notebook and the female graduate student signs it.
shots.narration: 写清拆到哪一步，哪些线没接。

shots.scene: 零件盒加盖，贴空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A parts tray with a lid and a blank label sits on top of the machine. No people.
shots.narration: 螺钉零件装盒标好，第二天接着干。

shots.scene: 试机时焊枪口朝向防护挡板，旁人退到黄线外
shots.prompt_en: During a test, the welding gun nozzle points at a protective metal plate while other people stand behind a yellow floor line.
shots.narration: 修好首次通电，枪口朝向挡板。

shots.scene: 操作者戴激光防护眼镜，旁边激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The operator wears laser safety goggles beside a laser warning sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 操作者戴好防护眼镜，旁人退开。

shots.scene: 一出现报警，老李马上按下急停
shots.prompt_en: When a warning light flashes, the facility engineer immediately presses the red emergency stop button.
shots.narration: 有异常立即急停，查明再试。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a battery with a lightning bolt, a ferrite ring, two hands under a box and a handover notebook.
shots.narration: 旧电源当带电件，磁环照原样。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 走线避锐边，中断要交接，试机看站位。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 电源换新，规矩照旧。下次见！
